items.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
items.description: Anthropic forbids its Claude models from generating sexually explicit content. But a series of tests conducted by TechCrunch found that it didn't take much to get past the restriction.

items.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
items.description: Nvidia continues to pour money into data center development — just as AI data centers bring lots of money into Nvidia.

items.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
items.description: Nvidia research shows that AI agents can perform well, and not go off the deep end, through fine-tuning, even if the AI model isn't that great at the task.

items.title: Bayesian Guardrails for AI Decisions: Measuring Uncertainty Before Automating Decisions
items.description: AI systems should not automate a decision simply because they can provide a prediction. A decision system should consider how uncertain the prediction is and defer if a mistake would be costly. The post Bayesian Guardrails for AI Decisions: Measuring Uncertainty Before Automating Decisions appeared
items.tldr: AIシステムは予測が可能だからといって自動的に決定を下すべきではなく、予測の不確実性を考慮し、誤りが高コストである場合には判断を保留すべきである。
